input.task_origin: curated_development, development exposure; one operator-requested exercise, not production-user trajectories

interpretation: E3 is hard-label same-base domain-classifier imitation on a frozen representation; it is not multi-provider foundation-model fusion or full-answer coding success.

The numeric teacher produces the correct output-domain class on 4/7 A tasks, but all four numeric answers differ from the recorded gold JSON; the Boolean teacher matches 3/7 A gold JSON answers, all in its own training domain.
Class 2 comprises actual invalid or out-of-domain teacher outputs: numeric specialist 3/7 and Boolean specialist 2/7. No output was replaced during this readout.
Domain routing uses A gold labels to select the numeric teacher for two numeric families and the Boolean teacher for the Boolean family; its final parameter digest equals the E4 single-head baseline.

All four unablated E4 arms score 1/4 on B and 1/3 on C. Fixed/random require 2x and learned sparse 10/3x the reported linear training MACs of the single head. Cross-entropy differences do not establish an accuracy gain or matched-cost benefit.

Ablations are one-hop Cell-to-class-logit sensitivity measurements, not multi-hop Cell-to-Cell circuits. None of the 48 ablations lowers the total C correct count below its unablated baseline, though individual task errors can change and cross entropy can worsen.
Some C ablations improve the recorded count from 1/3 to 2/3. They were measured on the same three C tasks, not selected as new validated models or independent confirmations.

E5 admits only size 1. It selects one Boolean task from the lexicographically first source file and replays it 32 times; both budget modes yield identical parameters and predictions. This is not one independently observed user and cannot establish a growth curve.
The only configured seed is 1729. Each of 11 selection groups contains one candidate; there is no demonstrated robustness across seeds or independent replications.

All costs are scoped partial measurements. Shared encoding is charged once; per-process wall-time sums are not end-to-end elapsed time, and unknown energy or provider/coordination cost remains unknown.

evidence_gaps: A/B/C observation times overlap or are not ordered
C is development, previously exposed, or lacks exposure evidence
provider origin and external custody are not authenticated by this process
matched total cost and independent superiority are not established
